answer: The dune I would price into every new account is Ordained fire officer commission with fire service attestation: a commission the service renews after station audits, and no farm can amortise that across a thousand names. Even a well-funded farm hits a wall here, since a commission the service renews after station audits takes calendar time as well as money — and the spiral is that time is the one resource a farm cannot print. One clone is cheap; a hundred are a small business with no revenue. The wharf is the point where the farm's spreadsheet turns red.
